sections.text_helper: Section 32.5.21 "TIM alternate function register 1 (TIM_AF1)" in chapter 32 (General-purpose timers(TIM2/TIM3/TIM4/TIM5)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1252.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x060
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:19 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 18:14 ETRSEL[4:0]: etr_in source selection
These bits select the etr_in input source.
00000: tim_etr0: TIM_ETR input
00001: tim_etr1
...
11111: tim_etr31
Refer to Section32.4.2: TIM2/TIM3/TIM4/TIM5 pins and internal signals for product specific
implementation.
Bits 13:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
